title: fix(console): Audit Log filter labels name their controls (objectui#13224)
body:
Fixes #13224

Clause-②: no

## What changed

In the Audit Log filter row (`apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx`), the Action, Actor, From and To labels named nothing. Each label now names its control's own `id` through `htmlFor`, the way the Object filter's label already did (`htmlFor={objectFilterId}`):

| Filter | Control that now carries the `id` |
|---|---|
| Action | the Radix `SelectTrigger`, a button and so a labelable element |
| Actor | the `LookupField` trigger `Button`: `id` is declared in the DOM pass-through block of `FieldWidgetComponentProps` and forwarded by `toDomProps` |
| From / To | the two date `Input`s |

Four `useId()` ids sit beside the filter state, next to `objectFilterId`. The filters' options, the query they send, and the classes and DOM structure of the row are unchanged.

## Mechanism hypotheses, measured

- **H1 (producer): confirmed.** Each of the four was a bare `Label` over a control with no `id` and no `aria-labelledby`. Id plumbing per control:
  - `SelectTrigger` spreads its props onto `SelectPrimitive.Trigger`, so `id` reaches the button. Radix puts `aria-labelledby` only on groups and item text, never on the trigger.
  - `LookupField` forwards `id` (listed in `DOM_PASS_THROUGH_KEYS`, `toDomProps.ts`) onto its trigger `Button`, the one element both of its render paths mount (the classic popover and the search-first `PeoplePicker`). It does not forward `aria-labelledby`, so `id` is its only labelling route.
  - `Input` spreads `id` onto the native input.
- **H2 (fix shape): confirmed, the `id` route for all four.** No control needed `aria-labelledby`, and `@object-ui/fields` is untouched, so no published prop was added.
- **H3 (controls): held.** The five existing `AuditLogPage*` suites, which pin the queries the filters send, stay green. The new suite's second and third tests drive the Action select and the two date fields found **by their labels** and assert the same `action` and `created_at` filters as before. Visual layout: the diff adds only `id` and `htmlFor` attributes; it was not measured in a browser.
- **H4 (acceptance): met, with the ablation below.**

## Tests

New: `AuditLogPage.filterLabels-13224.test.tsx`
- Action, Object, Actor, From and To each name exactly one control (`queryAllByLabelText(label, { exact: true })` has length 1), and it is that filter's own control: the Action select's trigger, the Object combobox, the Actor lookup's trigger (`lookup-trigger-user_id`) and two `type="date"` inputs, five distinct elements. The role queries by accessible name (`combobox` Action and Object, `button` Actor) resolve to the same elements.
- The Action control found by its label drives the `action` filter, and the From and To fields found by their labels drive `created_at` `$gte` and `$lte`.

Run at HEAD `a00e6154f`, clean tree, under the shared verify lock: `pnpm exec vitest run apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage apps/console/src/pages/system/auditLogActions.test.ts` gave `Test Files 7 passed (7)` and `Tests 42 passed (42)`.

**Ablation (fix reverted, test kept)**, after committing the fix as `5bf9258e4`: objectstack's `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` replaced the filter-row region with its `878a4af38` text (anchor 1 to 0, blob `3d71fbd1744b` to `3f69af83817c`) and ran the new suite. Result: `Tests 3 failed (3)`. Each test failed with `the "Action" label names exactly one control: expected [] to have a length of 1 but got +0`, except the date test, which failed on the From label. Restore proven: blob equals HEAD (`3d71fbd1744b`) and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Gates (local, at `a00e6154f`)

Each exit code was captured before any pipe.
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console lint`: exit 0 (0 errors).
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/console type-check`: exit 0. `tsc --listFiles` lists the new test file once, so the run covers it. The `@object-ui/console` dependency closure was built first.
- Changeset and citation gates, all exit 0:
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-presence.mjs`: "2 source file(s) of 1 released package(s) changed, and this change declares 1 changeset(s)".
  - `node scripts/check-changeset-no-major.mjs`.
  - `pnpm check:new-line-citations`: "0 new citation(s)".
  - `pnpm check:control-bytes`.
- Hand-derived families that read this diff, all exit 0: `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:i18n-keys`, `check:shell-escape-residue`, `check:unreferenced-sources` and `check:handler-key-reads`.
- `node scripts/check-governed-queue-guard.mjs --test` on the three paths: NOT GOVERNED.
- The full `check:*` farm and the full test shards run in CI.

## Acceptance notes

- Not measured: the card's live Chromium probe (`getByLabel(name, { exact: true })` against a running console) was not re-run. The happy-dom label query and the accessible-name role queries stand in for it.
- `lint` reports two warnings in this file: an explicit `any` in the load path, and the setState-in-effect warning on the effect that calls `load()`. Both are on lines this diff does not touch.
